name: piyaz
description: Use when the user wants to plan, decompose, track, or resume a multi-task project: scoping a new idea, importing or onboarding an existing repo or workspace, asking what to work on / what's next / what's blocked / where they left off, reporting task completion, dispatching work in parallel, or planning a draft task. Also when the user mentions Piyaz by name (e.g. "piyaz, do X") or references a task by its ref (e.g. VLT-9, KRN-153, PXD-31). Works for any project domain (code or data). Do not invoke for: one-off coding questions, single-file edits, debugging a specific error, generic todos, or scheduling.
